# frontier-wire

> An openly automated, bilingual (RU + EN) news wire covering AI, tech, science, world, culture and economy.
> Written twice a day by a scheduled agent from real, cited sources. Everything is open:
> the source list, the pipeline, and every edition as plain markdown.

Publisher: Danila Katalshov — https://adanman.github.io

## Machine-friendly entry points
- RSS feed: https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/feed.xml
- JSON Feed (with raw-markdown pointers): https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/feed.json
- Latest edition, plain markdown index: https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/latest.md
- Sitemap: https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/sitemap.xml
- Raw markdown of every article: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire/main/editions/<YYYY>/<MM-DD>/<NN-slug>.md
- Source list (RSS feeds we read): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire/main/feeds.txt
- Edition format spec: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire/main/FORMAT.md
- Repository: https://github.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire

## Latest articles
- [Ai2 tests why AI changes its verdict on a research idea's novelty](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-28/01-ai2-novelty-judges.html) — A new benchmark reveals sensitivity to question wording, especially when evaluating generated ideas.
- [LFM3 puts text, vision and audio models on a shared compact backbone](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-28/02-lfm3-specialized-models.html) — Liquid AI introduced six variants intended for specialization and deployment close to the application.
- [Oracle is developing access to business applications through ChatGPT](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-28/03-oracle-chatgpt-workspace.html) — The partners described an AI Workspace governed by company permissions and a U.S. Marketplace purchasing route.
- [NEO Surveyor's sunshade will block sunlight and supply spacecraft power](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-28/04-neo-surveyor-sunshade.html) — NASA detailed solar-cell integration and testing of a major component of the future infrared telescope.
- [CHAPEA crew prepares to leave its Earth-based Mars habitat on October 31](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-28/05-chapea-exit-planned.html) — NASA announced the planned end of its second isolation mission, with research findings still requiring separate analysis.
- [Anthropic expands discounted Claude access for US government buyers](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-28/06-claude-government-discount.html) — A GSA agreement offers a 40% discount, while purchasing routes and implementation support follow different timelines.
- [M6 MacBook Pro opens for preorders ahead of November 6 availability](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-28/07-macbook-pro-m6-preorders.html) — Apple announced a 14-inch model starting with 16 GB of memory, with performance and battery claims still coming from the manufacturer.
- [Landsat reveals the volcanic landscape beneath Chiricahua's rock spires](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-28/08-chiricahua-landsat-geology.html) — A new NASA feature uses July imagery to connect Arizona's canyons with eruptions roughly 27 million years ago.
- [Iceberg A-81 slows near South Georgia's underwater shelf](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-28/09-a81-south-georgia-drift.html) — NASA traced the berg from the Brunt Ice Shelf to the South Atlantic, while an October 20 image does not establish a final stop.
- [Perseverance measures dust that clings to spacesuit materials for years](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-27/01-perseverance-ultrafine-dust.html) — Calibration samples revealed particles down to hundreds of nanometers, informing future Mars-system design.
- [Cloudflare discloses a repaired GLM-5.3 request-isolation failure](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-27/02-cloudflare-kv-isolation-report.html) — The company reported 155 affected responses and explained why successful HTTP status did not establish correct processing.
- [ThinkingBox turns database checks into agent-training rewards](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-27/03-thinkingbox-training-repeatability.html) — The follow-up examines both average Qwen success and tasks completed correctly in all twenty attempts.
- [IBM combines four Granite models for time-series forecasting](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-27/04-granite-forecast-ensemble.html) — A recipe without retraining reduces architecture selection, but does not guarantee a better forecast on every series.
- [OpenAI releases data on the work activities people bring to ChatGPT](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-27/05-signals-work-activities.html) — Signals maps messages to 165 activity categories without directly measuring employment or productivity.
- [A climate project label does not establish how much new climate aid was added](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-27/06-climate-aid-accounting.html) — Our World in Data shows how denominators and secondary objectives change the interpretation of aid figures.
- [Polar Peaks introduces AI through data cleaning and model testing](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-27/07-polar-peaks-ai-literacy.html) — A new Google Research and Stanford Accelerator for Learning quest uses neuroscience as its teaching setting.
- [A Trainium support table shows which models passed a specific short test](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-27/08-trainium-model-support-tests.html) — Hugging Face publishes stack versions, scripts and outcomes, while PASS does not measure throughput or long generations.
- [iPhone Duo teardown separates repair access from fold durability](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-26/01-iphone-duo-repairability.html) — iFixit awarded a provisional 5 out of 10, noting accessible batteries and a difficult inner-display replacement.
- [IUCN reef assessment measures future risk, not 96 percent already lost](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-26/02-coral-reef-ecosystem-risk.html) — Climate projections sharply change threat classifications in a global analysis of 127 ecoregions.
- [CRISTAL opens its solar arrays on the ground ahead of environmental tests](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-26/03-cristal-deployment-tests.html) — The ice-monitoring satellite moves from assembly toward qualification, with launch targeted for late 2027 to early 2028.
